Author: Rayla Petal
Name: CoPose
Description:
Shared-control GPose scenes for Ktisis. Pair with someone nearby through Player Sync or Lightless (via SimpleHeels tags);
bone edits made by either player on either character show up live on both screens in GPose. Requires Ktisis and SimpleHeels.
Punchline: Pose together in GPose: either player can pose either character.
